The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Meaty Rice Balls}}
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meaty Rice Balls are [[Meal]]s that can be made by [[Cooking]] predominantly [[Hylian Rice]] together with some form of [[Meat]]. If consumed by [[Link]], they restore at least four of his [[Heart]]s. Meaty Rice Balls have a sweet and spicy taste. Link can add additional ingredients to the recipe for Meaty Rice Balls, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Meaty Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly ingredients. When eaten, they grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Meaty Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric ingredients. Link can eat them to gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Meaty Rice Balls}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring ingredients. They can be eaten to completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Meaty Rice Balls}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing ingredients. Eating them will refill part of Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Hasty Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Meaty Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty ingredients. Eating these rice balls will temporarily increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Meaty Rice Balls}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty ingredients. When eaten, they will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Meaty Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty ingredients. If eaten, Link gains a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Sneaky Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Meaty Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky ingredients. Eating them will provide Link with a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Meaty Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy ingredients. Consuming them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Meaty Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meaty Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The sweet and spicy meat stuffed into these rice balls will keep you full for some time.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough ingredients. They increase Link's defense when they are eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, Meaty Rice Balls can be made by [[Cooking]] a bundle of [[Hylian Rice]] with [[Meat]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Rice Balls |items= BotW, TotK }}
